policies.policyname: Org users can read own billing docs
policies.qual:
((bucket_id = 'billing-documents'::text) AND (has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) OR can_access_organization(
CASE
    WHEN (((storage.foldername(name))[1] = 'organizations'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text)) THEN ((storage.foldername(name))[2])::uuid
    WHEN ((storage.foldername(name))[1] ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) THEN ((storage.foldername(name))[1])::uuid
    ELSE NULL::uuid
END, 'documents.read'::text)))
